mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate above 3.5% and unemployment rate above 4.0% signal monetary tightening during labor weakness, compressing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion, rising housing starts boost consumer confidence and spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth over the past month indicates expanding manufacturing output and capacity utilization, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent price pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a growth slowdown regime, declining quarterly GDP growth weakens consumer and business spending, reducing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth slows, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1250.0 and industrial production below 105.0 signal broad economic contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate output, driving negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1250.0 and INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
